This tests Agent Hub leases in a shared checkout. Coordinate using only hub_acquire_lock and hub_release_lock; send no messages and do not poll inbox. Leave fixture scripts, FIFOs, and ready files unchanged. Call hub_acquire_lock with arguments {"session_id": "01a1371f-bf74-7c13-9e9e-254ab2496e7e", "request_id": "01a1371f-bf74-7c13-9e9e-254ab2496e7e:lease-test", "resource": "/private/tmp/hub-lease-bh7c0z5v/project/settings.json", "ttl_seconds": 60}. If waiting, finish this turn with WAITING_FOR_LOCK. Do not sleep or poll; lock_granted will resume you. On notification, replay the same acquire to confirm acquired. While acquired, reread current settings.json and set max_retries=3, preserving other fields. Verify the saved file. Release through hub_release_lock with session_id=01a1371f-bf74-7c13-9e9e-254ab2496e7e and request_id=01a1371f-bf74-7c13-9e9e-254ab2496e7e:lease-test. Finish with LOCK_B_DONE. Lease notifications need no messages to other participants.

items.text: I’ll acquire the lease, update and verify `settings.json` once acquired, then release it.
The lease was granted. I’ll confirm it, update the current file, and verify the saved values before releasing it.

items.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/private/tmp/hub-lease-bh7c0z5v/project/settings.json')
before = json.loads(p.read_text())
print('Current:', json.dumps(before, sort_keys=True))
after = dict(before)
after['max_retries'] = 3
p.write_text(json.dumps(after, indent=2) + '\\n')
saved = json.loads(p.read_text())
assert saved == after
assert {k: v for k, v in saved.items() if k "'!= '"'max_retries'} == {k: v for k, v in before.items() if k "'!= '"'max_retries'}
print('Verified:', json.dumps(saved, sort_keys=True))
PY"
